maintainer: Maintainer instruction recorded in Codex chat, 2026-08-01: continue DPA implementation autonomously through bounded DP3-DP5 slices with exact-ref evidence, rollback path and no global strict/conformance claim before DP3-DP5 closeout criteria are truly satisfied.

limitations: Observe applies only to the post-DP2 assessment and bounded DP3/DP4 adjudicated scope.
Observe records DPA stage findings without adding new blocking behavior for unrelated work.
Warn, block-new and strict remain blocked pending their own exact stage records.

commands.role: confirm DP2 selected self-hosting scope remains authorized and separate from Kit-wide DPA conformance
confirm bounded DP3 rollout and DP4 no-migration/manual-preservation adjudication
record DP5 stage blockers and keep Kit-wide conformance claims false
confirm handoff/status synchronization after the DP3/DP4 closeout refresh

unknown_mutation_safety_finding.rationale: Observe does not weaken existing mutation-safety fail-closed behavior. Unknown findings that affect mutation safety, authority interpretation, target identity, byte ownership or acceptance remain hard blockers for mutation claims.

observed_noncompliance.rationale: Observe-stage findings are visible in DPA assessment output but do not activate warn, block-new or strict enforcement.

rollback.rationale: Rollback from observe is record-only: remove or stop selecting this stage record and the post-DP2 assessment returns to DP5_NOT_COMPLETE with observe blocked. No production target mutation, strict gate state or generated-output patch is introduced by observe.
